g.text: TechZone — sale creation and safe retry
Matching in-flight requests share a promise; conflicting reuse returns 409.
[Existing key with different actor or ordered items]
[Existing key with matching actor and ordered items]
Commit only on success. Any failure aborts the whole transaction,
including all earlier stock/history writes and the sale.
Unique requestId guards retries across processes/restarts.
Duplicate-key recovery reads and validates the committed sale.
Driver retries and low-level model validation are omitted.
